system.text:
Official statistics from many national statistics offices and Eurostat. This server is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of them.

To answer a question with data:
1. Choose the country code. Call `list_countries` if you are not sure, and call it with a country code to read the hints for that office.
2. Call `search_tables` with the country and short topic keywords. Always search first, unless the user gives a table id. Use only table ids from search results or from the user.
3. Call `get_table_metadata`, then `query_table` with only the values you need. Use `latest` for recent periods.
4. To compare countries, query each country separately. Say which office each number comes from.

Always cite the source line that each result ends with. If you calculate new figures, say they are your own calculation.

content.text: What is the inflation rate in Slovenia?

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List the country codes, offices and languages. With a country code, show the hints for that office.

country.description: Country code from list_countries; "eu" is Eurostat.

tools.name: search_tables
tools.description: Find tables by keywords in their titles. Returns table ids, titles and publish dates, best match first. Search with short topic words, for example "unemployment municipalities", not full questions.

country.description: Country code from list_countries; "eu" is Eurostat.

lang.description: Language of your search words and of the labels, for example "is" for Icelandic. Default: the country's first language (see list_countries).

includeArchived.description: Also list discontinued tables, for older periods. Default false.

tools.name: get_table_metadata
tools.description: List the variables of a table and their value codes. Call this before query_table. Long value lists are shortened; use valueFilter to find specific values, for example a municipality name.

country.description: Country code from list_countries; "eu" is Eurostat.

tableId.description: Table id exactly as search_tables returns it.

lang.description: Language of your search words and of the labels, for example "is" for Icelandic. Default: the country's first language (see list_countries).

valueFilter.description: Show only values whose label contains this text, for example "Ljubljana".

tools.name: query_table
tools.description: Get data from a table as CSV with readable labels. For each variable, give value codes from get_table_metadata, or "latest" for the most recent N periods. Results above 5000 cells, or too large for the context, are refused with advice on how to narrow the query.

country.description: Country code from list_countries; "eu" is Eurostat.

tableId.description: Table id exactly as search_tables returns it.

lang.description: Language of your search words and of the labels, for example "is" for Icelandic. Default: the country's first language (see list_countries).

latest.description: Include only the last N values. Use it for time variables, for example the latest 4 quarters.

selections.description: One entry per variable to filter. Leave out variables you do not need.
